name: odoo-master
description: Agentic Odoo ERP engineering for Claude Code: version-aware Odoo 16-20 expert agents, project intelligence, validators, runtime testing in Docker, migrations, database safety, MCP capability discovery, Jira/GitHub/Slack ticket lifecycle, workflow engine with approval gates, evidence and PDF reports.

autonomy.title: Autonomy mode
autonomy.description: checkpoint: stop for human approval at every approval gate in a workflow. autonomous: auto-approve gates whose risk is at or below the policy threshold (high-risk and production gates always stop).

production_patterns.title: Production name patterns
production_patterns.description: Comma-separated regular expressions. Database names, hosts or Odoo URLs matching any of them are treated as production by the guard hook and database tools.

default_odoo_version.title: Fallback Odoo version
default_odoo_version.description: Used only when no version can be detected from the project. Leave empty to require detection or an explicit answer.
